segments.text: Thirdly, Be ſure of thy call to every buſineſſe thou goeſt about, though it be in the lea•t buſineſſe be ſure of thy call to it: then whatever thou meeteſt withal thou mayeſt quiet thy heart with this, I know I am where God would have me, there's nothing in the world will quiet the heart ſo much as this; when I meet with any croſs, I know I am where God would have me in my place and calling, I am about the work that God hath ſet me, Oh this will quiet and content thee when thou meeteſt with trouble: that that God cals a man to with that he may have comfort in whatſoever befals him, God is to look to thee, and to ſee thee bleſt if thou beeſt in the work God cals thee to.
